module.Title: Stop an Unsafe Sequence
module.Teaching: break immediately exits the nearest loop. It is useful when an alarm makes continued operation unsafe.
module.PredictionQuestion: What happens when emergency_stop becomes True?
module.PredictionExplanation: break transfers execution to the first line after the loop.
module.DebugPrompt: continue skips one iteration but does not stop the sequence.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the emergency-stop loop with break. Use these exact identifiers: emergency_stop, f, print, range, second. Use these exact values: 60, "Running: {second}".
module.TransferPrompt: Stop checking sensors as soon as critical_alarm becomes True. Use these exact identifiers: f, print, range, sensor. Use these exact values: 8, "Sensor {sensor} checked".
module.PreviewMessage: Unsafe equipment sequences can now terminate immediately.
